content.text:
Done. Here's what was changed and committed:

**`wrangler.toml`** — two new `[[containers]]` sections:
- `SIDECAR_SERVICE` → `paperclip-sidecar` image (handles `/internal/heartbeat`, `/internal/plugin-jobs/*`)
- `PLUGIN_CONTAINER` → `plugin-sandbox` image (handles `POST /execute`, `POST /cancel/:runId`)

**`env.ts`** — `SIDECAR_SERVICE?: Fetcher` and `PLUGIN_CONTAINER?: Fetcher` added; `SIDECAR_URL`/`SIDECAR_API_KEY` demoted to optional fallbacks.

**`heartbeat.ts`** — step 2 now calls `this.env.SIDECAR_SERVICE.fetch("http://sidecar/internal/heartbeat")` when the binding is present; only falls back to the KV-read URL if not.

**`plugin-dispatch.ts`** — KV is read once per run (not 3× across 3 steps); lifecycle calls (claim, complete) go through `sidecarPost()` which prefers `SIDECAR_SERVICE`; the execute step routes to `PLUGIN_CONTAINER` when `executorMode === "container"` and the binding exists.

The fallback to KV-stored `SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL` is kept in both workflows so you can still point at an external bridge if you ever deploy without containers.
